providerDescription: Choose the verification service used by this scene. The built-in POW provider is recommended.
title: Captcha provider configuration
description: POW (proof of work) is used by default. You can switch to GeeTest 4.0 or Cloudflare Turnstile. The provider is validated by the backend and falls back to the default scene when it is unavailable.
globalDescription: Controls captcha checks for login, registration, verification-code delivery, password reset, password change, and every other protected scene.
globalDisabledDescription: While disabled, the backend bypasses every captcha check. Provider and scene settings remain saved but inactive.

tags.priority: Per-scene settings; scenes without their own provider inherit the default

sceneDescription: Checked operations require a captcha. Unchecked scenes run without one and keep their provider configuration.
difficultyTip: Higher difficulty takes longer to calculate. 3 to 4 is recommended.
languagePlaceholder: For example: zho or eng; blank follows the browser
actionPlaceholder: Blank uses the current scene name
hostnamePlaceholder: For example: api.example.com, without protocol or port
cdataPlaceholder: Letters, digits, underscore and hyphen only; challenge ID is appended
thirdPartyDescription: Secrets are encrypted and stored only on the server. Provider timeouts, configuration errors and verification failures deny the request.
loadFailed: Failed to load the captcha configuration. Please try again later.
noPermission: You do not have permission to save
defaultSceneDescription: Used when a scene has no dedicated configuration
